component.name: Railbench
component.summary: Native Rust model railway track planning, 3D viewer, and simulation tool

description.p: Railbench is an intuitive, fast native Rust track planning and layout simulation application supporting major scale models (H0, TT, N, Z, 0, 1, G) with authentic manufacturer geometries, intelligent snap connectors, hardware-accelerated 3D visualization, and real-time electrical traction simulation.

ul.li: Comprehensive library of 23 track systems and 7 street catalogs: Märklin (C, K, M, 1, Z), Trix, Piko, Roco, Fleischmann, Minitrix, Peco, Kato, Tillig, Kühn, Rokuhan, Lenz, LGB, and Bachmann E-Z Track
Precision 2D CAD canvas with zoom (+/-), pan, tab-scoped selection/editing, and customizable keyboard shortcuts
Hardware-accelerated 3D viewer (wgpu) with terrain sculpting, automated mountain tunnels, CAD ViewCube, 3D editing, and transparent depot shed roofs
Detachable Drive, 3D Cab View, and Signal Box (Stellwerk) window for locomotives, turnouts, turntables, and transfer tables
Real-time electrical voltage drop simulation, catenary overhead wiring, and short-circuit fault detection
Layer management, continuous slope/helix ramp calculator, 1:1 vector PDF blueprint printing, and Part List (BOM) export

screenshot.caption: 2D CAD Track Planning with exact turnout geometry and electrical simulation
Interactive 3D elevation view with terrain, realistic lighting, and CAD ViewCube
Dedicated Terrain and Mountain Editor with automated tunnels and custom layout sketcher

description.p: Release 26.11.1: Native Rust architecture (egui + wgpu) replacing the legacy Electron shell, WCAG AA light/dark theme contrast, Drive & Signal Box window, 3D editing in Hall & CAD modes, transparent engine shed/roundhouse roofs, tab-scoped selection, simplified Part List, and built-in vector PDF blueprint export.

Release 0.6.1: Real-time automatic ramp generation updates, instant live preview calculation on start point or shape changes, multi-language visual guide in Help dialog, and track context menu refinements.

Release 0.6.0: Full 360/180 3D camera freedom with interactive CAD ViewCube, 2D CAD Sketcher for freeform tables and layer plates, dedicated Terrain & Mountain Editor with sculpting brushes and automatic 3D mountain tunnels, steam locomotive coaling station and diesel fueling station 3D models, Kato Unitrack & Bachmann E-Z Track systems, +/- zoom and arrow key panning, and custom keyboard shortcut mapping.
